verdict.rationale: Zulip explicitly supports self-hosting with official install docs, import/export tools for migrating from Zulip Cloud, and is genuinely FOSS (not open-core) per community sourcing; a live self-hosted instance (chat.zulip.org) confirms this works in practice. However, multiple hands-on community reports describe the self-hosting install process as painful, requiring a dedicated server/VM, poor Linux distro support beyond Ubuntu, and container support that 'doesn't work really well,' indicating real friction despite official claims of parity with Zulip Cloud.
